__________________________________________
IMPORTANT!
Memory is alligned at buffer->freelist
OR buffer->data address
__________________________________________
1.
  Create parent objects of type buffer_t.
  Create children objects of type buffer_t
  to the parent buffer.
2.
  Destroy children buffers.
  Destroy parent buffers
3.
  repeat proccess in a loop
  print memory to file.

 childrens capacity:16*2=32
